rubrics.justification: Core morphology matches the provided 4BA grading and hatching appearance, but the response adds likely unverified image findings such as vacuolation, fragmentation, asymmetric herniation, and extruded debris.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, prior cycle, sperm quality, BMI, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis, though some links are overstated.
Overall structure is logical, but several probability modifiers are somewhat arbitrary and some conclusions rely on unsupported assumptions from the image and cycle context.

SET recommendation and general prognosis are guideline-consistent, but ERA after a single failed cycle, routine aspirin, prolonged luteal support framing, and strong protocol claims for DOR are not well supported as standard guidance.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and future planning, including SET and protocol discussion, though some suggested adjuncts are not strongly evidence-based.
